card.name: Essay prose about history and society
card.fires_on: Words in formal expository prose on history, religion, culture or society, often just after a sentence opens (According, Their) or inside a long clause. It does not depend on one specific word.

modes.label: Sentence openers
modes.description: First word of a new sentence in analytical essay text, such as According or Their.

modes.label: Inside long clauses
modes.description: Linking or adverb words in the middle of a long descriptive sentence about history or culture.

card.writes: It promotes strong descriptive words like crippling, pressing and strained, which suggests it adds forceful academic wording.
card.plain: It lights up in formal essay writing about history and society, as the sentence moves on to explain or argue.
